div.p: On an Order Server, the placer decides whether an order is actionable, either by tagging the MedicationRequest or by creating a Task that points at it. When a Task coordinates the work, the placer also closes the MedicationRequest once the Task is completed.

description.value: The system that asks for chocolate, by posting an order to a Spenser Unit or by placing one on an Order Server.
